title: Ensemble machine learning predicted FRP-to-concrete bond strength
summary: An ensemble model predicted bond strength for fiber-reinforced polymer laminates bonded to concrete using a 136-sample test database. The study compared its predictions with standalone models; the result is limited to the assembled engineering dataset.
ai_technology: Ensemble machine-learning regression for FRP-concrete bond strength.

evidence.tested: The model was assessed on a 136-sample database and compared against standalone prediction models.
evidence.unknown: Database-based evaluation; performance on new materials or field conditions was not established.
